name: calcom_create_booking
description: Book a slot on an event type. Provide `start` (UTC ISO-8601, one of the open slots), `eventTypeId`, and the attendee's `name` and `timeZone` (required) plus optional `email`, `phoneNumber`, and `language`. Optional `lengthInMinutes` overrides the event's default duration. The booking is created in cal.com and synced into the user's connected destination calendar (e.g. Google Calendar); confirmation emails are sent. Returns the booking `uid`.

start.description: Booking start time, UTC ISO-8601 (must be an open slot).

timeZone.description: Attendee's IANA time zone, e.g. America/New_York (required).

email.description: Attendee's email (recommended — where the confirmation is sent).

lengthInMinutes.description: Override the event type's default duration, in minutes (optional).
